catalog.scope: Strict scalping only; separate from all prior 15-minute/210-minute intraday experiments
catalog.preset_label: preset-scalp is the existing modeled closed-bar EMA20/50, RSI55/45 and MACD histogram alignment interpretation; not an exact broker implementation
catalog.entry: Exact next available minute open only when it coincides with the fully closed signal decision; complete lane minutes required
catalog.exits: Fixed stop, fixed target, hard UTC holding cap, pre-news cutoff or lane cutoff; no opposite-signal exits and no breakeven/trailing experiments

costs.basis: HistData minute bid OHLC with conservative fixed modeled asks; no measured full-period spread claim
costs.maintenance_breach: Reject the path from selection and qualification; do not invent a broker-specific liquidation fill

catalog.news_policy: Unchanged strict 60/30-minute macro, 90/60-minute central-bank, full-day uncertainty/holiday and New York 16:45-17:15 rollover controls

training_selection.per: instrument and lane; freeze before any new 2024 replay
training_selection.ranking: Eligible first, then both base-cost training years having at least 25 trades, then highest worst training account net across years/costs, then base-cost training trade count; retain first catalog entry on ties
training_selection.fallback: If none eligible, retain the training-ranked diagnostic benchmark labeled unqualified; no advancement to holdout

loss_attribution.scope: Prior fixed gold NY intraday baseline, 2022-2023 only; descriptive associations, never a trading filter in this batch
loss_attribution.volatility: ATR14 / closed signal close * 10000; low/middle/high split at the 2022 complete NY-lane decision-bar 25th and 75th percentiles, fixed for 2023
loss_attribution.causality: Entry features use the last fully closed signal candle; never future returns or exit candles

catalog.promotion: Disabled. 2024 is reused development evidence. Fresh untouched evidence, PF > 1.5, net expectancy > 0, DD < 10%, >= 200 distinct completed trades, stressed costs and stability are all required.

2024_status: Previously used development evidence, never untouched out-of-sample

loss_conditions.scope: Prior intraday benchmark training, not strict scalp results
loss_conditions.interpretation: Descriptive overlapping stratifications, not causal proof or optimized filters

limitations: Known 2023 incomplete session windows are excluded
Retrospectively retrieved calendars are not point-in-time archives
Fixed conservative modeled costs; no full-period tick execution proof
No volume or manipulation intent inferred from OHLC
Independent account totals are not a shared-capital portfolio
A margin-maintenance breach invalidates a path; no invented broker fill
